title: Mutually Adversarial Self-Training with Evolving Data for Unified Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) combine image generation and visual understanding in a shared backbone. Since generation and understanding are inverse tasks, recent studies self-train UMMs by letting the two branches cooperatively supervise each other. We introduce MATE (Mutually Adversarial self-Training with Evolving data), a reinforcement-learning-based post-training framework in which the two branches instead challenge each other, and the challenges evolve as the model trains. MATE lets generation and understanding take turns to be challenger and solver. Given an image, the understanding branch proposes several candidate descriptions that the generation branch must turn back into similar images, and vice versa. The candidates are screened for consistency with the image or prompt they were proposed from, and the solver is trained on the candidate it handles worst. translated_title: 面向统一多模态模型的基于演化数据的互对抗自训练
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在共享骨干网络中同时实现了图像生成与视觉理解。由于生成与理解是一对互逆任务，近期研究通过让两个分支协作地相互监督来对UMMs进行自训练。我们提出了MATE（基于演化数据的互对抗自训练），这是一种基于强化学习的后训练框架，其中两个分支转而相互挑战，并且挑战会随着模型训练不断演化。MATE让生成分支与理解分支轮流扮演挑战者与解题者：给定一张图像，理解分支提出若干候选描述，生成分支必须将这些描述还原为相似的图像，反之亦然。候选内容会根据其与来源图像或提示的一致性进行筛选，解题者则在其处理得最差的候选上进行训练。由此，对抗性来源于模型自身的输出，而无需单独的……
tldr: MATE是一种基于强化学习的后训练框架，让统一多模态模型的生成与理解分支轮流互为挑战者和解题者，利用模型自生成且随训练不断演化的挑战数据相互对抗，从而同时提升图像生成与视觉理解能力。
en_tdlr: MATE is a reinforcement-learning-based post-training framework in which the generation and understanding branches of unified multimodal models alternately act as challenger and solver, adversarially training each other on self-generated, evolving challenge data to jointly improve both image generation and visual understanding.
